💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Hushpuppy: Wound the lead. Wound the lead and the pack breaks. Hit the FIRST wolf — the one that came in first — and the coordination dies. They fear fire, but breaking the lead is free. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — ducks in a row: Break the line. The line is one animal, but only while it's whole. Strike a duck that ISN'T the head and the line splits — both halves hunt on their own and the formation dies. Break the line, then thin the pieces. (You did the thing — and it worked.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Flashbulb Moth: Hit it while it folds. The Wing Flash only fires FORWARD — it must face you. Circle while it folds its wings and hit it before the wings open. It can't flash what's behind it. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Dustboar: Step OFF the lane — and hold your breath. When it paws the earth, step OFF the lane — sideways, not back — and cover your mouth. The dust blinds it too; it charges where you WERE. Wait for the cough, then strike. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)
